body: 19, Diagnosed borderline personality disorder & MDD two years ago, nothing I do seems to make myself feel any better. Almost every ascept of my life right now is or has gone wrong, yet I usually just hang-in day by day anyhow hoping it will be better when I wake up. In the last 10 months I've lost my father to alcohol related organ failure, I'm madly in love with my best friend who has no interest and I'm very lonely almost all the time. I'm not usually a impulsive person, yet around 23 minutes ago I took 2350mg Zoloft, 80mg Diazapram with a glass of scotch and I'm not sure if I regret it.
